pr_title: Fix `client_id` not generated when connecting to the MQTT broker
pr_body:
<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
With #136130 the MQTT client was bumped. In that change the generation of the `client_id` was assumed to be generated automatically, which is not correct. When no `client_id` is set only for protocol version 3.1, al client id was generated. The previous behavior now has been restored.

This explains why some users could recover their setup by downgrading to MQTT v3.1. This should no longer be needed after this fix.

issue_context.title: MQTT failed to connect due to empty client ID in Connect Command message after upgrade to 2025.3.1
issue_context.body:
### The problem

My MQTT Integration worked well in old core version. I upgraded the core to 2025.3.1 this morning due to there is a upgrade notice.

Then I found my Entities related to MQTT brokes after core restart. I removed the integration and try to re-add the MQTT integration back but failed with the same reason "Failed to connect"

I use wireshark tool found out the client ID is empty, so my MQTT broker rejected it. That's why MQTT said failed to connect.
But there is no client ID option when I am trying to add MQTT intetration.

<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

Thank you, it seems you revealed a regression with MQTT client that was caused in the last version.
I think this should be able to fix. For the time being

The `client_id` could be left empty in case the protocol. is version 3.1.
To enable those setting you must enable advanced settings on you profile.
See linked fix. To work a round you could set a `client_id` manually or set the protocol to version 3.1

Thanks for quick response and suggestions. I will not change the settings and leave the environment to verify the fix when new version available. 

BR
Confirmed it works on core-2025.3.2 which has the fix.
